question: Who wrote the book ‘Gulamgiri’?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Jyotiba Phule__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Jyotiba Phule was the founder of **Satyashodhak Samaj in 1873**.
 
• Social activist Vithalrao Krishanji Vandekar gave him the title of** "Mahatma"**
